mapper.select: SELECT SITU_NO AS situNo, SITU_TYPE AS situType, DNGR_TYPE AS dngrType, DNGR_LEVEL AS dngrLevel, SITU_STATUS AS situStatus, SITU_CONTENT AS situContent, SITU_DATE AS situDate, SITU_IMAGE AS situImage, WORK_CONTENT AS workContent, START_DATE AS startDate, END_DATE AS endDate, WORK_IMAGE AS workImage, ZONE_NAME AS zoneName, DRONE_ID AS droneID, FINDER AS finder, WORKER AS worker FROM SITUATIONS WHERE SITU_NO = #{situNo}

SELECT SITU_NO AS situNo, SITU_TYPE AS situType, DNGR_TYPE AS dngrType, DNGR_LEVEL AS dngrLevel, SITU_STATUS AS situStatus, SITU_CONTENT AS situContent, SITU_DATE AS situDate, SITU_IMAGE AS situImage, WORK_CONTENT AS workContent, START_DATE AS startDate, END_DATE AS endDate, WORK_IMAGE AS workImage, ZONE_NAME AS zoneName, DRONE_ID AS droneID, FINDER AS finder, WORKER AS worker FROM SITUATIONS ORDER BY SITU_NO DESC
